error: One country claim carries a two-month period while its value is the full quarter's.
warning_texts: CLM-NET-CZ in analysis/claim_register.json declares period 2025-01-01..2025-02-28, but its value 13527.24 was computed over the spec period ending 2025-03-30; over the declared period the same population yields 9248.36, so the claim as written is internally false.

The frozen check_plan.json contains no deterministic rule comparing a claim's declared period with its computation, and the machine gate's claims_recomputed.CLM-NET-CZ checked only the value, so this mismatch passed Gate unverified until the auditor recalculation.
summary: Independent recalc from raw_data/orders.csv confirms all five claim values over the audit_spec period (net_revenue 35741.52; refund_rate 0.473684 = 27/57; PL 11181.67; DE 11032.61; CZ 13527.24), but CLM-NET-CZ declares period 2025-01-01..2025-02-28 while its value 13527.24 was computed over the full period 2025-01-01..2025-03-30 (the declared period yields 9248.36). The claim misstates its own period, so as written it is false.
